modelRouting.routingRationale: One disjoint edit-only Pull contract lane owns deterministic requirement, provider-capability, coverage, receipt, delivery-acknowledgement and catalog-persistence seams.

objective: Implement only PUL-001, PUL-002, PUL-003, PUL-019, PUL-024, PUL-031, PUL-032, PUL-037 and PUL-039 through versioned additive extensions: normalize request facts deterministically; derive monotonic task-scoped requirements from bounded generic task lexical signals plus typed request facts, while prose never grants identity, authority, scope or effect; select capability-qualified acquisition; map exact candidate IDs across acquired, eligible, admitted, represented, fenced, emitted and retained stages; preserve missing/dropped required evidence as unsatisfied; persist content-free exact delivery acknowledgements in ContextCatalog; retain byte-stable prefix and suppression correctness only through acknowledgement-bound state. Preserve every existing V1 field and meaning. Do not edit active Pull federation, PPL, Blueprint, hook, native-consumer, lifecycle, Hub/package or qualification paths.

hostile prose, monotonicity, capability fallback, coverage and stage-map acceptance

workers.task: Implement this exact bounded Pull extension. Add RequirementFactV1, EvidenceRequirementSetV1, AcquisitionPlanV1, RequirementEvidenceMapV1 and CandidateJourneyV1 as versioned serde extension contracts. Normalize typed request facts: taskId defaults requestId when absent; repository/worktree, grant, anchors, budgets, deadline and policy epoch remain explicit. Deterministically classify bounded generic task lexical signals into task-scoped evidence dimensions even with no prestructured harness requirements; these signals may select evidence needs but can never grant identity, authority, scope or effects. Caller-supplied structured requirements may add or strengthen, never weaken. Provider catalog records capabilities, independent authority/freshness/readiness/cost and typed omission, then picks progressive capability-qualified providers with deterministic fallback. Map each exact evidence ID across acquired, eligible, admitted, represented, fenced, emitted and retained; required evidence dropped by Push/fence stays unsatisfied, never silently delivered. Preserve V1 request/response fields and semantics by using named versioned extensions. Implement ContextCatalog storage and public Pull acknowledgement helper for idempotent acknowledgements bound to installation ID, repository ID, request ID, trace ID, context epoch, publication ID, representation digest and packet digest. Missing, wrong, stale, compacted, restarted or response-lost acknowledgement must restore eligibility; never use boolean suppression. Do not edit federation.rs, federation_sources.rs, corrective.rs, protocol, active PPL files, docs, Cargo manifests/locks, Hub/package, lifecycle, Hook, Blueprint, or qualification files. Worker runs no commands beyond source inspection and edits.

externalDependencies.contract: After this worker returns frozen public acknowledgement API plus catalog schema, PPL owner refreshes its own dispatch/receipt and changes only reserved engine/crates/membrane-runtime/src/pull/delivery_state.rs, cache_prefix.rs and pull_post_merge_acceptance.rs. Suppression and prior-prefix reuse must consult exact persisted acknowledgement binding, not process-local selected state or retainsDeliveredEvidence boolean; unknown, wrong, expired, compacted, restarted and response-lost state restores eligibility. Return frozen hashes plus focused acceptance.

externalDependencies.contract: Only owner of engine/crates/membrane-runtime/src/pull/federation.rs refreshes its own dispatch/receipt and wires public native_route_response/run_federate pipeline: generic task request -> normalized requirement compiler -> capability acquisition -> candidate stage map -> Push representation -> publication fence -> recomputed surviving IDs/coverage -> pending publication record -> response extension delivery observation. It must ingest next-request exact acknowledgement, emit named strength/outcome observations for PUL-032, and never suppress before exact acknowledgement validation. No schema/catalog reimplementation.
